versions.changelog:
Initial release of jiebang-cron-task – an AI Agent scheduling and task management tool.

- Create, query, complete, and delete scheduled tasks with Cron expression and natural language support
- View execution logs and task histories, including success/failure status
- Use 12 preset templates for common scenarios (e.g., daily reports, stock alerts)
- Tasks can be filtered by labels and completion status
- Automatic API Key generation on first use; free with usage limits
